claims.statement: CBAM's definitive regime applies from 1 January 2026 and introduces authorisation, reporting, certificate-purchase and surrender obligations.
CBAM initially covers cement, iron and steel, aluminium, fertilisers, electricity and hydrogen imports.

economics.acquisition_route: Win Polish importers through customs brokers, then invite their suppliers into shared passports
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated: 700 plants at 12000 PLN average recurring revenue could exceed 8m PLN ARR; 65% founder ownership could exceed 5m PLN equity in years 5-7
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated: 75-90% after onboarding once evidence mappings are reusable
economics.pricing: Unvalidated: 6000-18000 PLN per plant/year plus 200-500 PLN per importer share
economics.retention_or_repeat: Annual subscription plus recurring shipment, methodology and facility updates

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Supplier-to-importer evidence reuse and exception history create a cross-company data network
fingerprint.customer: Non-EU steel, aluminium, cement and fertiliser suppliers plus their Polish importers
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Customs brokers, trade associations and Polish import-accounting partners
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Structured evidence vault, methodology checks, versioning, consented sharing and verifier-ready exports; no assurance claim
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Supplier pays annual passport subscription; importers pay per accepted data share
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A definitive-regime shipment needs credible embedded-emissions evidence for importer reporting and verification

founder_fit: Warsaw base supports EU B2B launch
Asynchronous product avoids constant social selling
risks: ERP vendors may add similar workflows

structure.control_point: permissioned plant-level source-data graph and change history
structure.critical_dependency: Importers and accredited verifiers must accept the packet format while retaining their legal duties

thesis: Build one permissioned emissions evidence packet per non-EU plant that can be safely reused across its Polish/EU importer customers and handed to accredited verifiers.
title: CBAM Supplier Evidence Passport
uncertainties: Willingness to pay and evidence reuse rates are unvalidated
Final verifier acceptance patterns are unknown
